style: Warm, gentle, tactile and playful casual pet rescue feedback. Avoid piercing highs and epic combat sounds.
negative: Speech, voices, singing, background music, drums, distortion, static noise, ambience, loud harsh sounds, long reverb, sirens, explosions.

cues.prompt: A single soft bubble pop sound effect. One small round plop, a warm tactile button click. Close-up, dry, isolated sound on a silent background. Cute gentle casual game interface sound, very brief clean decay.
A single small rounded rising bloop with a gentle airy swish. A cute playful popup opening sound effect, soft warm tone, short clean decay. Isolated studio recording on silence, no other sounds.

Two soft wooden marimba plinks rising in pitch, followed by one cute bubble pop. A brief friendly magical combination sound effect. Warm, playful and rounded, isolated dry close-up sound on silence, no musical accompaniment.

A short cheerful three note major key xylophone notification chime. Three warm wooden plinks rising in pitch, gentle and reassuring, a small happy success sound effect. Soft rounded notes with short decay, isolated sound on silence, no backing track.

A short two note bell chime sound effect, a delicate rounded ding ding rising in pitch with a brief sparkling tail. A gentle collectible reward notification for a cute casual game. Not piercing, clean isolated sound on silence.

Two soft muted kalimba notes, doop doop, a short friendly wooden notification sound effect. Low rounded mellow tone, gentle reminder, calm rather than alarming. Clean dry isolated close-up sound on silence.
